points.description: First valid privileged action named and explained: e.g. writing to CR3 (change page directory pointer), writing EFLAGS (change execution status/interrupt enable), writing IDTR (change IDT location), or accessing a kernel-range virtual address. Must state what the action does/would change; the OS/hardware prevents it (e.g. via privilege level/trap).
points.partial_credit: Half if the action is named correctly but the explanation of what it does is missing or vague.

points.description: Second, different valid privileged action named and explained, from the same kind of list (CR3 write, EFLAGS write, IDTR write, kernel VA access, or an equivalent privileged action a user process could specifically attempt). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if the action is named correctly but the explanation is missing or vague.
